info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - High Availability

get.description:
Retrieve redundancy configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace redundancy configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update redundancy configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove redundancy configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
